title: Snare drum make, Conn drums and tuning
summary: He used Leedy and Conn drums, notes Conn made the first nickel-plated drums, and tuned snare to F and bass drum to D.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used
